name: Conferences & Annual Meets
title: Conference Management Company Delhi | ETHPL
meta: Conference and annual meet management from Delhi: venue, delegate registration, AV and staging, speaker logistics and an on-site desk.
tagline: Venue, staging, delegates and speakers — one accountable team.
intro: A conference is the event where things going wrong is most visible. Registration queues, a microphone that fails during the keynote, a speaker whose flight was not tracked. We plan against those specifically, because that is what the day is judged on.
included: Venue sourcing against your delegate count, format and staging needs
Delegate registration, badging and an on-site help desk
AV, stage, lighting and backdrop production coordinated as one scope
Speaker travel, accommodation and green-room logistics tracked individually
Hotel room blocks near the venue, with a rooming list you can edit
A written run-of-show, and a contingency plan for the parts that can fail
questions: Do you handle the content and speakers themselves?
We handle their logistics — travel, stay, timing, green room, stage readiness. The programme and who speaks is yours; we make sure they are in the right place, on time, with working equipment.
What about hybrid or streamed sessions?
Streaming and recording can be built into the AV scope. Tell us at the briefing stage, because it changes the venue requirement and the internet provisioning.
How early do room blocks need confirming?
Earlier than most teams expect. For a conference with out-of-town delegates, blocks are the first thing to lock — the venue is usually available long after the nearby hotels are not.
